title: Forgery
grade_or_penalty: 3rd degree if the writing is currency, securities, government-issued documents, prescriptions or similar; otherwise 4th degree
key_points: Altering, making, completing or issuing a writing so it purports to be authentic or authorized when it is not, with purpose to defraud or injure.
Possessing forgery devices is also covered.
elements: The suspect altered, made, completed, executed, authenticated, issued or transferred a writing, OR uttered a writing he knew was forged
So that it purported to be the act of another who did not authorize it (or of a fictitious person or at a different time or place)
With purpose to defraud or injure anyone, or knowing he was facilitating a fraud or injury
